question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**deserve**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the clause is “ethical and social implications,” which is **plural**.
 
• The sentence is in the **present tense**, as indicated by "As technology continues to evolve".
 
• Therefore, the plural subject “implications” requires the **base form verb** “deserve” to agree in number and tense.
 
• Other options like “deserves” (singular), “deserving” (participle), and “deserved” (past tense) do not fit the present plural structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The evolution of technology has (1) **led__** to unprecedented advancements in various fields, from medicine to communication. The invention of the Internet, in particular, (2) **__catalysed__** a global revolution, altering how people connect and share information. Innovations in artificial intelligence and machine learning (3) **__promoted__** automation and efficiency, transforming industries and creating new economic paradigms. As technology (4) **__continues__** to evolve, ethical and social implications (5) **__deserve__** significant consideration.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Deserving – Present participle; cannot act as the main verb in this sentence.
 
• Deserves – Singular present tense; incorrect for plural subject “implications.”
 
• Deserved – Past tense; inconsistent with the present context.
 
• Deserve – Base verb form; correctly matches plural subject and present tense.
